meta.title: Hisn
meta.description: Hisn is a student initiative at King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals that works year-round as an incubator for defense-industry talent: it introduces students to the sector, prepares them for its roles and connects them with its organizations. «مؤقت»

dept.SECTOR_AWARENESS.description: This department introduces students to the defense sector as it really is: a broad set of industries spanning aerospace, electronics, communications, cybersecurity and manufacturing, not weapons alone. We meet specialists from the sector's organizations who explain where they work and how a student can start out, whatever their major. «مؤقت»
dept.CAREER_READINESS.description: The department prepares students to enter the sector: a CV that technical organizations will read, mock interviews with recruiters, and workshops on career paths, summer internships and co-op training. «مؤقت»
dept.SYSTEMS_INTEGRATION.description: Aircraft, radars and communication systems bring dozens of disciplines together in one product. The department explains how requirements are written and how systems are designed and tested until they work together. «مؤقت»
dept.CYBERSECURITY.description: Protecting sensitive systems, data and infrastructure. Sessions for those who write code, and for those who work in policy, governance and risk management. «مؤقت»
dept.MANUFACTURING_DESIGN.description: From idea to product: materials engineering, mechanical design, 3D printing, quality, and the supply chains that localization depends on. «مؤقت»
dept.DATA_ANALYSIS.description: An industry built on precision, where data drives the decisions: from predictive maintenance to supply planning. The department introduces students to data analysis, visualization and AI in industry. «مؤقت»
dept.CAREER_READINESS.role2: Engineer in a graduate development program «مؤقت»

talent.what.title: What is the talent pool? «مؤقت»
talent.what.body: A list that students choose to join, so that people looking for talent in the sector's organizations can get to know them: for summer internships and co-op training, graduate development programs and jobs. No particular major is required; every major has a place in the sector. «مؤقت»
